network_status.summary_it: Le stazioni di Brugnato sono sul Vara, che riceve il Gravegnola; il valore del fiume ricevente non viene trasferito al ponte sul tributario, interessato anche da colate detritiche.
network_status.summary_en: The Brugnato stations are on the Vara, which receives the Gravegnola; the receiving-river value is not transferred to a tributary bridge also affected by debris flows.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
